address: LF, JW Marriott, 8 Do Duc Duc Road, Me Tri Ward, South Tu Liem District, Hanoi, 100000, Vietnam
bio: This elegant hotel restaurant boasts a sleek, spacious dining room oozing with special occasion indulgence. Counter seats offer a view of the huge open kitchen and create a connection between the chefs at work and the diners. The contemporary French culinary score is consummately executed with subtle Asian twists, flanked by equally immaculate, spot-on, courteous service. Private dining rooms are available for everything from date nights to business dinners....
